judged_text: Unbounded limit parameter on groups members endpoint: params[:limit] has no upper clamp, allowing full materialization and serialization of entire group membership; previous 200 cap for automatic groups was removed (app/controllers/groups_controller.rb ~line 22)

adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` is used directly in `.limit(limit)` with no upper bound, so a client can request an arbitrarily large `limit` and cause a very large query and JSON serialization (`members: serialize_data(members, ...)`). However, the finding’s claim that a prior hard 200-cap was “removed” is not strictly supported: the old code used a default of 200 only for automatic groups and did not clamp `params[:limit]` either, and non-automatic groups previously returned all members unpaginated. So the unbounded-limit concern is real and diff-grounded, but it’s more of a hardening/perf issue than a clear newly introduced defect/regression.
